globalRules: Enter the correct link or username. Private accounts and wrong targets are not refundable.
Do not place another order for the same target until the previous one is completed, partial, or canceled.
Speeds and start times are estimates and can change with server load.
Complaints are accepted after 24 hours from order placement.
If the target already has 100,000+ followers/likes/views/subs, refill protection does not apply.
Partial or canceled orders are refunded automatically to your balance.
Orders cannot be canceled for user input mistakes.

categoryRules.igFollowersFlag: Disable Instagram "Flag / Report for review" (Settings → Follow and invite friends) so new followers appear automatically. No refill/refund if this stays enabled.
categoryRules.igFollowersUsername: For followers, enter the username only (not a private account).
categoryRules.postUrl: For likes, views, reactions, and comments, paste the exact post/media URL from the description.
categoryRules.commentsLines: For custom comment services, enter one comment per line. Quantity must match the number of comments.
categoryRules.publicProfile: Make sure the profile is public and the username/link matches the service requirements.

commentsRequired: Enter at least one comment (one per line).
commentsCountMismatch: You entered {{count}} comment(s) but quantity is {{qty}}. They must match.
bankNote: Send the exact order amount. Include your order reference in the transfer note if possible.
